owner: Kael parent owns final synthesis; operator decides RED items
default_rule: GREEN can act and log; YELLOW proposes a default in #decisions; RED never defaults and requires explicit operator GO plus receipt.

GREEN.definition: Reversible, low-risk, preapproved work inside existing approved mission scope; agent acts and logs.
allowed_examples: read local files and approved APIs

YELLOW.definition: Decision-bearing or externally visible setup work where the agent should propose a default in #decisions and wait for operator approve/override unless already explicitly approved.
allowed_examples: create internal Discord channels approved by contract

RED.definition: Never-default actions: spend, unpausing ads, external replies, investor/human replies, legal/identity, bulk sends on new domains, patient-list contact, irreversible deletes, or anything embarrassing if wrong.

venture_send_rules.allocant: Sender wrappers refuse RED or unapproved items. First-touch/follow-up motion resumes only after sample formatting approval, G-A1 checks, evidence card, and explicit GO.
venture_send_rules.glp: B2B owner outreach/build/affiliate work is unblocked before HIPAA/counsel/A2P, but patient-list contact stays blocked until Gate-0; no PHI/patient-list action.
venture_send_rules.boring-ai: Manual preview delivery only after operator approves the preview URL/package; no auto-DM/comment/postcard/email-first outreach until evidence card + GO.

operator_approval_receipt.wording: GREEN autonomous+logged; YELLOW propose-with-default in #decisions; RED never-default + explicit GO/receipt.

standing_rules.trigger: FIRST paid sale in any venture
standing_rules.operator_console_item: Upgrade GHL to Agency Pro $497 so SaaS-mode rebilling is wired fully; if the sale was GLP also decide P10 HIPAA add-on.
standing_rules.pushover: Upgrade GHL to Agency Pro $497 so SaaS-mode rebilling is wired fully; if the sale was GLP also decide P10 HIPAA add-on.
